description: Frozen pre-payment-freeze Android ledger schema DDL. Synthetic upgrade tests insert data separately.
version1: CREATE TABLE installation (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(id)=36))
CREATE TABLE device_key (slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(slot=1), fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE intents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_id TEXT UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE receipts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, intent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES intents(id), document_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, issued_at TEXT NOT NULL, total_fils INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_fils>0), payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, envelope_hash TEXT NOT NULL, envelope_json TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE outbox (receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id))
CREATE TABLE acknowledgements (receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id), payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, ack_json TEXT NOT NULL, acknowledged_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER receipts_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER receipts_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER acknowledgements_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON acknowledgements BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER acknowledgements_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON acknowledgements BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER installation_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON installation BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER installation_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON installation BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER device_key_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON device_key BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER device_key_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON device_key BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER device_key_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON device_key WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM device_key) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'device_key_exists'); END
CREATE TRIGGER installation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON installation WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM installation) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'installation_exists'); END

CREATE TRIGGER receipts_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON receipts WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM receipts WHERE id=NEW.id OR intent_id=NEW.intent_id OR document_number=NEW.document_number) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'receipt_exists'); END
CREATE TRIGGER acknowledgements_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON acknowledgements WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acknowledgements WHERE receipt_id=NEW.receipt_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ack_exists'); END

CREATE TRIGGER intents_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON intents WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.request_hash IS NOT OLD.request_hash OR NEW.request_json IS NOT OLD.request_json OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR (OLD.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.receipt_id IS NULL OR NEW.receipt_id IS NOT OLD.receipt_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_intent'); END
CREATE TRIGGER intents_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON intents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_intent'); END
CREATE TRIGGER intents_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON intents WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intents WHERE id=NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'intent_exists'); END
version2: CREATE TABLE offline_bundles (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, snapshot_envelope TEXT NOT NULL, authority_envelope TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE offline_authority_state (authority_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES offline_bundles(id), next_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(next_number>0), gross_fils INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(gross_fils>=0), clock_json TEXT NOT NULL, blocked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(blocked IN (0,1)), seal_envelope TEXT)

CREATE TABLE offline_chain (slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(slot=1), key_epoch TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>=0), event_hash TEXT, CHECK((sequence=0 AND event_hash IS NULL) OR (sequence>0 AND length(event_hash)=64)))

CREATE TABLE offline_intent_context (intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES intents(id), authority_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES offline_bundles(id), order_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, document_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE offline_intent_cancellations (intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES offline_intent_context(intent_id), reason TEXT NOT NULL, cancelled_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER offline_bundles_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_bundles BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_bundles_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_bundles BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_intent_context_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_intent_context BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_intent_context_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_intent_context BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_intent_cancellations_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_intent_cancellations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_intent_cancellations_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_intent_cancellations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_bundles_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON offline_bundles WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_bundles WHERE id=NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'bundle_exists'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_context_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON offline_intent_context WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_intent_context WHERE intent_id=NEW.intent_id OR order_id=NEW.order_id OR document_id=NEW.document_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'intent_exists'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_cancellation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON offline_intent_cancellations WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_intent_cancellations WHERE intent_id=NEW.intent_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'cancellation_exists'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_state_monotonic BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_authority_state WHEN NEW.authority_id IS NOT OLD.authority_id OR NEW.next_number<OLD.next_number OR NEW.gross_fils<OLD.gross_fils OR NEW.blocked<OLD.blocked OR (OLD.seal_envelope IS NOT NULL AND NEW.seal_envelope IS NOT OLD.seal_envelope) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'custody_rollback'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_state_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_authority_state BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'custody_delete'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_state_replace BEFORE INSERT ON offline_authority_state WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_authority_state WHERE authority_id=NEW.authority_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'custody_replace'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_chain_monotonic BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_chain WHEN NEW.slot IS NOT OLD.slot OR NEW.key_epoch IS NOT OLD.key_epoch OR NEW.sequence!=OLD.sequence+1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'chain_rollback'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_chain_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_chain BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'custody_delete'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_chain_replace BEFORE INSERT ON offline_chain WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_chain) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'custody_replace'); END
version3: CREATE TABLE offline_seal_confirmations (authority_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES offline_bundles(id), seal_payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, response_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE offline_upload_exceptions (receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(id), exception_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(receipt_id,exception_id))
CREATE TRIGGER offline_seal_confirmations_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_seal_confirmations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_seal_confirmations_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_seal_confirmations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_upload_exceptions_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON offline_upload_exceptions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END
CREATE TRIGGER offline_upload_exceptions_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON offline_upload_exceptions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_record'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_seal_confirmation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON offline_seal_confirmations WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_seal_confirmations WHERE authority_id=NEW.authority_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'confirmation_exists'); END

CREATE TRIGGER offline_upload_exception_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON offline_upload_exceptions WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_upload_exceptions WHERE receipt_id=NEW.receipt_id AND exception_id=NEW.exception_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'exception_exists'); END
